skill.summary: Provides 10+ deployable AI agent architecture templates with personas, toolkits, workflows, and success metrics for diverse professional roles.

latestVersion.changelog:
Major update: Comprehensive redesign and rebranding as "Agent Builder" with production-grade AI Agent architecture templates.

- Introduced 10+ detailed AI Agent templates (e.g., customer service, sales, engineering, ops), each with full personas, toolkits, workflows, and metrics.
- Added step-by-step usage methods: select template, custom agent design, and multi-agent orchestration.
- Defined core architecture elements for every agent: identity, capabilities, tools, workflow, metrics, security guardrails.
- Expanded documentation and included related references (roles library, orchestration, self-improving agents).
- Provided practical trigger phrases and usage instructions for seamless integration.
